class.name: IfcRelCoversBldgElements
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI : The IfcRelCoversBldgElements is an objectified relationship between an element and one to many coverings, which cover the building element. IfcRelCoversBldgElements , this relationship, expresses the primary relation to the element, IfcRelCoversSpaces expresses the primary relation to the space.
